root_cause.text: The `virt_wifi` driver uses `SET_NETDEV_DEV` to set the parent of its net device to the lower device, which can lead to a use-after-free when ethtool operations access `dev->dev.parent` after the lower device has been freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `SET_NETDEV_DEV(dev, &priv->lowerdev->dev)` from `virt_wifi_newlink` in `drivers/net/wireless/virtual/virt_wifi.c`, and the commit message states that `ethnl_ops_begin()` calls `pm_runtime_get_sync(dev->dev.parent)` on a freed lower device during unregistration.

candidates.rationale: The SET_NETDEV_DEV macro sets the parent of the virtual wifi net device to the lower device. When the lower device is freed, dev->dev.parent becomes a dangling pointer, leading to a use-after-free when accessed by ethtool operations.
